root_cause.text: The failure path in `ttm_bo_swapout()` reinserts the swapped-out resource to the tail of the LRU list via `ttm_resource_move_to_lru_tail()`, which places it ahead of the LRU walk hitch node, causing the same resource to be visited again when iteration resumes, leading to an infinite loop.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description states: "However, ttm_resource_move_to_lru_tail() places the resource at the tail of the LRU list which, relative to the walk cursor's hitch node (placed immediately after the resource when it was yielded), puts the resource *in front of the* the hitch. The next list_for_each_entry_continue() from the hitch finds the same resource again, causing an infinite loop." The fix removes the bulk_move deletion and the subsequent LRU reinsertion from the failure path, performing them only on success.
